Ezingaqinisekile kakhulu yi-Yoruba, i-Amharic, i-Oromo, i-Igbo, i-Shona, i-Hausa, isiZulu, i-Khmer, i-Papiamento ne-Haitian Creole. Amanothi amade ekhathalogi emodeli ngayinye akhona ngesiNgisi, isiPutukezi nesiSpanishi futhi abuyela esiNgisini kwenye indawo. Ukubuyekezwa ngumkhulumi womdabu kungomunye wemisebenzi ewusizo kakhulu ongayenza.
59cb1486: Ihlolwe ikakhulukazi emshinini owodwa we-Windows 10. I-Linux ne-macOS akuhlolwanga, kuhlanganise nokulanda nokudonsa injini ye-.tar.gz.
13d0fec5: I-GPU (ukwakhiwa kwe-Vulkan kwe-llama.cpp) ayikahlolwa ehardware yangempela.
d07e5029: Injini ye-Buriti i-CPU kuphela. Ku-ARM64 ama-kernel e-NEON aqinisekiswe ngokulingisa, ukwakha ngokuphambene nokuhlolwa kwawo ngokwawo (bekungekho mshini we-ARM), ngakho isivinini sawo asikalinganiswa.
1d985d98: Isivinini se-prefill samamodeli e-1B kuya ku-3B: ama-kernel anemiyalelo emincane ku-multiply-accumulate ngayinye, i-AVX-VNNI, ukwakhiwa kwe-release ye-LTO nokuphinda kulinganiswe i-Llama 3.2 3B.
52a7d453: NEON: linganisa ku-ARM yangempela (Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi 5); sebenzisa i-sdot.
07310d8b: Izakhiwo eziningi (Gemma 2, i-Gemma 3 enkulu, Mistral Nemo/Small) nama-quantizations asele (Q2_K, Q3_K, Q8_K, IQ*).
3639d5b2: Ukusatshalaliswa: amafayela akhiwe yi-CI (MSVC ku-Windows), iphasiwedi enkulu noma i-keystore ye-OS yesihluthulelo somlando (okuyikhetho), ikhathalogi ebuyekezekayo.
4d8d0183: Rekhoda isinqumo ngasinye sokuklama ku-docs/DECISIONS.md nalokho okulinganiswe nalokho okungakhonjiswanga.
ea8b457a: Umbhalo wesixhumanisi ufakwa ku-web/i18n*.js ezilimini zonke ezingu-34, ngokushiya abagcini bendawo abafana ne-{threads} bengashintshiwe.
832a827f: Bhala izivivinyo ze-kernel ngokuqhathaniswa nereferensi ye-float, futhi utshale iphutha ngamabomu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isivivinyo esisha siyahluleka.
a8153c25: Qinisekisa izakhiwo ezintsha nge-token ids nama-logits ngokuqhathaniswa ne-llama.cpp (ifayela le-F16 kufanele lifane kuze kufike cishe ku-0.003), hhayi ngokubheka okukhiphayo ngamehlo.
d1cdf3c0: Uma ulinganisa isivinini, shintshanisa ukusebenza ne-llama.cpp, sebenzisa kubanda, phinda izikhathi ezi-3 noma ngaphezulu futhi umbike isimo; ungabizi ingxabano ngokuthi inzuzo.
89ee24d6: Bheka ikhodi namafayela asebenzayo abantu abangaphandle njengangethenjwa: buyekeza ngaphambi kokusebenzisa noma yini.
2e744d82: Sebenzisa izivivinyo nge-cargo test (izivivinyo ze-unit ezingu-30 kanye nokuxilongwa okungu-7 okushiyiwe). Izindaba, imibiko yokuhlola evela ezinkompyutheni ze-Linux, macOS ne-ARM, kanye nokubuyekezwa kokuhumusha konke kuyamukelwa ku-indawo yokugcina ye-GitHub.
67a9b283: I-Buriti ilayisensiwe ngaphansi kwe-PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. Ayikho inkokhelo ekusetshenzisweni okungelona ukwezohwebo: ukusetshenziswa komuntu siqu, ucwaningo, ukuhlolwa, amaphrojekthi okuzijabulisa, ukufunda, nokusetshenziswa yizinhlangano zomusa, izikhungo zemfundo, ucwaningo lomphakathi, ukuphepha noma impilo yomphakathi, nezinhlangano zemvelo nezikahulumeni. 0bf5e60c: Lena ilayisense lapho ikhodi yomthombo itholakala kodwa kunemikhawulo yokusetshenziswa, hhayi ilayisense yomthombo ovulekile ephasiswe yi-OSI, ngoba ayivumeli ukusetshenziswa kwezohwebo. Isifinyezo esingenhla asiwukweluleka ngokomthetho: okubalwayo yinkulumo yelayisense.
f521592e: Amamodeli anamalayisense awo, azimele kweleBuriti, futhi ilayisense yeBuriti ayiwaguquli. Amanye adinga ukuvuma umthombo, amanye anciphisa ukusetshenziswa okuthile noma ayalela ukusetshenziswa kwezohwebo. Funda imigomo egcwele ekhadini lemodeli ngayinye ngaphambi kokuyisebenzisela ezohwebo.
b655d40b: Okuncikwayo: ngo-2026-11-23 kwahlolwa ilayisense eshiwoyo yelinye nelinye lawo ama-crate e-Rust angu-254 iphrojekthi encike kuwo, futhi wonke ayavumela (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, Zlib, Unicode-3.0 noma afanayo); lokhu akuyona i-audit yezomthetho. b34cd2b0: I-Buriti yakhelwe emibonweni nasemifomethi yamafayela ye-llama.cpp nefomethi ye-GGUF, futhi injini yayo ihlolwa uma iqhathaniswa ne-llama.cpp.
af772d24: Izimpande zayo zigona inhlabathi manzi futhi zivikele imithombo ezala imifula. Phakathi kwamaqabunga ayo aluhlaza aqinile ayisimo sefeni nokukhazimula kwegolide kwezithelo zayo, i-buriti iguqula indawo ibe yisiphephelo, ukudla nenkumbulo ephilayo ye-sertão.
2b83bf18: I-vereda ngayinye iwumoya wokuqabuleka phakathi nesomiso, umhlangano ongcwele womhlaba, umoya namanzi agobhozayo. Ukunakekela i-buriti kuwukunakekela umthombo ogcina iCerrado iphila futhi ishaya.
26d4f982: Enhliziyweni yeCerrado, lapho ilanga lifudumeza khona umhlaba futhi umkhathizwe uvela ungenasiphetho, i-buriti ilokhu imi njengomlindi othulile wamanzi. Lapho kukhona i-buriti, kukhona amanzi, isithembiso sasendulo esihola abahambi, izilwane nezizukulwane eduze kwama-veredas.
9ee465f0: Buriti - iseva ye-LLM yasendaweni elula futhi elula ukuyisebenzisa, ebhalwe nge-Rust
87e9ffab: Isiqhubi sasendaweni samamodeli e-AI esilula futhi esinobungane, esifinyeleleka kuwo wonke umuntu futhi esizivumelanisa nezimo ezahlukene zekhompyutha nezezimali. Iseva encane yasendaweni ebhalwe nge-Rust enesixhumi esibonakalayo sewebhu ngezilimi ezingu-34, eqhuba amamodeli e-GGUF, inezinjini ezimbili ongakhetha kuzo: llama.cpp, noma injini ye-Rust emsulwa ye-Buriti uqobo.
22f6ccfc: I-Buriti ifuna ukwenza amamodeli e-AI afinyeleleke kuwo wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi labo abavame ukushiywa ngaphandle ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza: ifayela elilodwa elincane lomdabu elizivumelanisa nenkumbulo nesiphakamisi onakho, yonke into ilungiswa ngesixhumi esibonakalayo sewebhu, futhi ukhetha ukuthi imodeli iqhutshwa kanjani. I-Ollama bekuyisikhuthazo nomhlahlandlela ekuqaleni kwephrojekthi.
a8c0ecb4: Injini yethu vs llama.cpp (build b12606): Intel Core i7-7500U (ama-core angu-2 / ama-thread angu-4, i-AVX2 kuphela), ama-thread angu-4, i-CPU kuphela, Q4_K_M ngaphandle kokuthi kuthiwe okunye, ukusebenza okushintshanayo, imijikelezo emi-3, ama-median, i-prompt engaba ngama-token angu-560, i-build yentuthuko (opt-level 3, ngaphandle kwe-LTO), kukalwe ngo-2026-11-24
1c717d01: Izinsimbi zamafomethi e-Q4_K, Q6_K, Q8_0 ne-Q5_0 ziphinde zipakishwe zibe yimigqa ehlangene lapho imodeli ilayishwa. Ithebula langaphambili kuleli khasi, elinge-prefill engu-66% no-69% ekilasini le-1.5B, kufakwe lelithi esikhundleni salo.
46ca552d: Ku-NVIDIA GeForce 940MX (4 GiB, Vulkan) nge-Qwen 2.5 0.5B Q4_K_M, injini yethu ifinyelele ku-202 tok/s ye-prefill uma iqhathaniswa no-167 tok/s we-Vulkan build ye-llama.cpp (121%), no-22.1 tok/s wokukhiqiza uma iqhathaniswa no-24.4 (91%): ama-median emijikelezo emi-3 eshintshanayo ngemva kokuphumula kwamasekhondi angu-60. Yi-GPU eyodwa nemodeli eyodwa, ngakho thatha lokhu njengesikhombisi kuphela.
6903bb2e: I-prefill iyalingana noma ingaphezu kwe-llama.cpp kuwo wonke amamodeli angu-12 (101 kuya ku-184%). Ukukhiqiza kuphakathi kwe-91 kuya ku-109% we-llama.cpp, okungukuthi kusondele kodwa akukho phambili.
4fd3163a: Akukalinganiswa: umthwalo owengeziwe we-Ollama uqobo, isivinini ku-ARM64, noma iyiphi i-CPU ngaphandle kwalena (lapha akukho AVX-VNNI noma AVX-512), amasimu amade (i-prompt ingaba amathokheni angu-560) futhi, ngale kwesampula elincane, ikhwalithi yezindlela ze-Q8_0 ne-Q5_0 ezipakishwe kabusha uma kuqhathaniswa ne-llama.cpp. I-Phi-3.5 mini iyasekelwa kodwa ayikho kule thebula: izilinganiso zendlela yayo ye-Q5_K bezinomsindo omkhulu ukuba zishicilelwe.
